name: Local tasks
description: Tasks in a JSON file on this computer. It needs no account. Each repository of the projects is a collection.

settings.label: Keep the tasks in the repository
settings.description: On: the tasks are in .shipwarden/tasks.json in the main worktree of each repository. Your team can commit this file. Off: the tasks are in ~/.shipwarden/tasks on this computer only. ShipWarden does not move the tasks when you change this setting.

settings.label: Statuses
settings.description: The status names in workflow order, with commas between them. The default is "To do, In progress, Done". A name such as "Done" or "Canceled" sets the category of the status.
